acceptedAnswer.text: The free Front Door Audit decides it. If your site is salvageable, the Fix. If it is not, a Build. If your front door is already fine, the audit says so and you owe nothing. Front Door, the monthly service, is for shops that want it run for them after the build.

Month to month. Cancel with 30 days notice. Deposits are non-refundable once work begins; unused prepaid months are refunded. Managed services pause at day 14 unpaid; your site stays up at least 60 days. You own your domain, your listing, your content and your data at all times.
